subject.title: Skill-draft semantic dedup: duplicate drafts with different hash suffixes

question: What duplicate policy should Skill Workshop use before writing a new auto-created proposal?
rationale: The code clearly lacks semantic coalescing, but the requested embedding threshold and duplicate counter would create new persisted proposal semantics that automation should not invent.

options.title: Normalize first
options.body: Use a deterministic normalized-content plus skillKey comparison for recent pending proposals, and add embeddings only if deterministic matching is insufficient.

options.title: Approve semantic coalescing
options.body: Adopt the requested embedding-similarity threshold and duplicate counter as a new proposal metadata contract with tests and docs.

options.title: Keep manual cleanup
options.body: Leave creation behavior unchanged and rely on operators to reject duplicate proposals through the existing lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Normalize first
recommendation.body: Use a deterministic normalized-content plus skillKey comparison for recent pending proposals, and add embeddings only if deterministic matching is insufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and merged the original Skill Workshop and Skill Research feature and later refactored the same proposal write boundary.
